findings.title: The app loads without errors
findings.detail: The home screen loaded in 1.8 seconds with no console errors.

findings.title: No placeholder content
findings.detail: The pricing screen still shows "Lorem ipsum" text and a stock placeholder image.

evidence.caption: Lorem ipsum in the plan description

findings.title: A privacy policy is reachable in the app
findings.detail: No link to a privacy policy was found in settings, the footer or the sign-up screen.

evidence.caption: Settings screen without a privacy link

findings.title: An account can be deleted in the app
findings.detail: Users can create an account but there is no way to delete it from inside the app.

evidence.caption: Account screen only offers sign out

findings.humanStep: Confirm that deleting an account also removes the user's data from your backend, not only the login.

findings.title: Third-party login comes with an Apple option
findings.detail: The app offers Google sign-in but no Sign in with Apple or equivalent option.

evidence.caption: Only the Google provider is configured
Re-check: Apple button renders but sign-in fails

findings.humanStep: Create a Services ID and key for Sign in with Apple in your Apple Developer account, then add them to the auth settings.

findings.title: No app-builder badge or default branding
findings.detail: A "Made with an app builder" badge is shown in the bottom corner and the tab title is the template default.
findings.humanStep: Switch off the builder's badge in your app builder's project settings; its hosting adds the badge, not your code

findings.title: No tracking or third-party AI calls before consent
findings.detail: Network traffic before consent could not be captured, so this rule was not checked.

findings.title: "Just a website" risk
findings.detail: The app is a thin wrapper around the website with no native features, which is a likely rejection risk.

evidence.caption: App only loads the remote website URL

findings.humanStep: Consider adding features that work best as an app, such as offline habits, reminders or widgets.

fixes.summary: Replaced placeholder pricing copy and image.
Added a Delete account button with confirmation to the account screen.
Added the Apple provider; needs Apple Developer credentials to finish.
